name: Explore the house
description: Cupboards, the yard, under the porch: the whole world, as far as you know.

outcomes.text: You found the jar of sweets everyone thought was well hidden.
You met your first crab under the porch, and the crab won.
You climbed into the loft and found {parent}'s old things: a coat, a knife, a letter you could not read yet.
You wandered off and had half of {home} out looking for you before supper.
